text:
You need a HubSpot CRM Manager who can turn CRM data into strategy, cleaner operations, and revenue growth for NexGen Cloud.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, and data workflows. I can help design CRM processes, improve data architecture, and turn reporting into actionable insights for KPI tracking and performance monitoring.

In a past project for Marrow & Pine Grocers, I built weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores, scheduled in Airflow and written back to BigQuery. That work reduced WAPE from 31% to 19% and cut spoilage write-offs by 11% in pilot stores.

I’d bring the same structured, data-driven approach to HubSpot CRM so your team can improve visibility, efficiency, and decision-making.
